records.title: Aleto cohort: professional network
records.claim: 93% of the 2025 Aleto group felt they grew their professional network.
records.reportingPeriod: 2025 Aleto cohort; programme ran over nine months; exact dates not stated

source.title: 2025 Make A Mark Report
source.location: Printed p. 10 (PDF p. 9), Aleto Leadership Programme; footnote 4 points to the 2024–2025 Aleto Foundation impact report

records.reviewNote: The report describes perceived growth, not an independently measured increase. Its footnote attributes the data to the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team x Aleto Foundation Leadership Programme Impact Report 2024–2025.
limitations: The denominator, response count, survey question, and survey method are not stated in this report.
Preserve the participant-reported qualifier; do not describe this as objectively measured network growth.

records.title: Aleto cohort: skills and confidence
records.claim: 90% of the 2025 Aleto group felt they grew their leadership skills, public speaking and confidence.
records.reportingPeriod: 2025 Aleto cohort; programme ran over nine months; exact dates not stated

source.title: 2025 Make A Mark Report
source.location: Printed p. 10 (PDF p. 9), Aleto Leadership Programme; footnote 4 points to the 2024–2025 Aleto Foundation impact report

records.reviewNote: The report combines leadership skills, public speaking and confidence in one participant-reported outcome. Its footnote attributes the data to the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team x Aleto Foundation Leadership Programme Impact Report 2024–2025.

records.title: Students engaged at Make A Mark Week
records.claim: The fourth annual Make A Mark Week engaged 257 students in STEM and career development workshops.
records.reportingPeriod: 2025 Make A Mark Week; exact event dates not stated

source.title: 2025 Make A Mark Report
source.location: Printed p. 11 (PDF p. 10), Make A Mark Week

records.reviewNote: The report describes two full days of activity and says the workshops were delivered with partner organisations.
limitations: The report does not explain whether this is a unique-student count, attendance count, or another participation measure.
This reach figure does not measure learning or later career outcomes.

records.title: Avoided air freight emissions
records.claim: The report states that 1,188 tCO₂e were avoided, equivalent to 88,153 laps around Silverstone Circuit.

source.title: 2025 Make A Mark Report
source.location: Printed p. 9 (PDF p. 8), footnote 2; methodology also printed p. 24, footnote 14

records.reviewNote: Footnote 2 attributes avoided emissions to SAF certificates and says they were verified by the report's limited assurance. Footnote 14 describes air freight calculation using 2025 DEFRA conversion factors and reductions attributed from 2025 SAF certificates.
limitations: The reported value is avoided emissions and should not be recast as a measured inventory reduction.
The Silverstone-lap equivalence uses 2025 DEFRA petrol conversion factors and circuit lap distance.

records.title: Travel and logistics emissions reduction
records.claim: AMF1 reports a 14% reduction in travel and logistics emissions through more efficient logistics and investment in Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF).
records.reportingPeriod: 2025 results (exact measurement dates and comparison baseline not stated)

source.title: 2025 Make A Mark Report
source.location: Printed p. 9 (PDF p. 8), 2025 impact highlights; see also printed p. 24, footnote 14

records.reviewNote: The report attributes the reduction to more efficient logistics and SAF investment.
limitations: The report does not identify the comparator period or full calculation boundary for the 14% headline.
Do not present this as a reduction in all team emissions or all Scope 3 emissions.
